meta.title: Raise a "New Activity" purchase intake request and trigger its approval workflow
gaps: Navigate to the Intake page and create an intake request.
Enter the request title and select the New Activity condition.
Advance through Basic Details and Details, select currency, and fill custom fields.
Search and select a product, enter quantity and unit of measure, and select the delivery location.
Review and confirm the approval chain, submit the intake, and verify that the approval workflow has started.
